description: This file implements the Messenger plugin for the WPEFramework, including initialization, room management, message sending, subscribing to user updates, and helper functions for room ID generation.

classes.name: Messenger
classes.description: The Messenger class manages chat rooms, message distribution, and user subscriptions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: const string Initialize(PluginHost::IShell * service)
methods.description: Sets up the Messenger service with the provided shell interface, initializes room management resources, and registers the service.

methods.name: void Deinitialize(PluginHost::IShell * service)
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters from room administration, releases held references, and resets internal state.

methods.name: string JoinRoom(const string & roomName,const string & userName)
methods.description: Allows a user to join a specified room and returns a room ID if successful.

methods.name: bool SubscribeUserUpdate(const string & roomId,bool subscribe)
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes a user update callback for a given room ID.

methods.name: bool LeaveRoom(const string & roomId)
methods.description: Removes the user from the specified room and releases resources.

methods.name: bool SendMessage(const string & roomId,const string & message)
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified room.

methods.name: string GenerateRoomId(const string & roomName,const string & userName)
methods.description: Generates a unique room ID based on room name, user name, and current time, utilizing SHA1 hash.

ctags.name: GenerateRoomId
ctags.pattern: /^    string Messenger::GenerateRoomId(const string& roomName, const string& userName)$/

ctags.name: JoinRoom
ctags.pattern: /^    string Messenger::JoinRoom(const string& roomName, const string& userName)$/

ctags.name: SendMessage
ctags.pattern: /^    bool Messenger::SendMessage(const string& roomId, const string& message)$/

ctags.name: SubscribeUserUpdate
ctags.pattern: /^    bool Messenger::SubscribeUserUpdate(const string& roomId, bool subscribe)$/
